segments.ja343:2.1: Yo ve kate paṭikate, kibbise paṭikibbise;
segments.ja343:2.3: Evaṃ taṃ sammatī veraṃ, vasa kuntini māgamā.
segments.ja343:3.1: Na katassa ca kattā ca, metti [mettī (pī.), mittī (ka.)] sandhīyate puna;
segments.ja343:4.1: Katassa ceva kattā ca, metti sandhīyate puna;
segments.ja343:4.3: Dhīrānaṃ no ca bālānaṃ, vasa kuntini māgamāti.
